channel.title: Holistic Life: Home Workouts for Beginners
channel.description: Home Workouts for Beginners guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: At Home Workout Plan for Beginners: Three 15-Minute Days a Week
item.description: An at home workout plan for beginners that fits a real week: three 15-minute workout days, with an easy walk or rest in between. Five low-impact moves, no equipment, and a four week way to build up slowly. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Low Impact Workout at Home for Beginners: Start Where You Are
item.description: A low impact workout at home for beginners, with every move offered in an easier and a harder version. Plan three short sessions a week and build habits at your own pace. A gentle way to start the New Year. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Beginner Workout at Home: 15 Minutes, Five Easy Moves, No Gym Needed
item.description: A beginner workout at home for anyone who wants a simple place to start. Warm up, do five gentle moves, then cool down. Includes a weekly schedule and a four week way to build up slowly. Guide contains affiliate links.
